---
title: "hESC Irradiation — Differential Expression Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)

# Load WIBR3 WT filtered Seurat object
hesc <- readRDS("irradiated_hESC_object.rds")
```

```{r}
hesc
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(hesc) <- "RNA"
Idents(hesc) <- hesc$Gy

DEGenes0vs10 <- FindMarkers(hesc, ident.1 = "CTRL", ident.2 = "10Gy")
write.csv(DEGenes0vs10,"DE_Statistics/DEStats0vs10.csv")
DEGenes0vs5 <- FindMarkers(hesc, ident.1 = "CTRL", ident.2 = "5Gy")
write.csv(DEGenes0vs5,"DE_Statistics/DEStats0vs5.csv")
DEGenes0vs2 <- FindMarkers(hesc, ident.1 = "CTRL", ident.2 = "2Gy")
write.csv(DEGenes0vs2,"DE_Statistics/DEStats0vs2.csv")
DEGenes0vs05 <- FindMarkers(hesc, ident.1 = "CTRL", ident.2 = "0.5Gy")
write.csv(DEGenes0vs05,"DE_Statistics/DEStats0vs0_50.csv")
head(DEGenes0vs10,20)
```
